name: 21853 · Princess Anne, MD
findings: ZIP 21853 (Princess Anne) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21853 (Princess Anne) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21853 (Princess Anne) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
